ski: Rain with the snow level near ~7,500 ft gives way to dry weather Wednesday and Thursday, and a system Friday brings snow to the Washington Cascades with the snow level near ~5,900 ft. Snow coming: Hurricane Ridge gets 4 in at 5,150 ft and the Mount Adams backcountry 13 in at 7,795 ft by Saturday, NWAC has no rating posted. Best ski day: Mission Ridge and Wenatchee on Thursday, good weather window all day, through 10 PM, NWAC has no rating posted.
hike: Rain and wind with the snow level near ~7,500 ft ease Wednesday, dry weather holds Thursday, and a system Friday brings snow to the Washington Cascades above ~5,900 ft.
